findings.highlight: It is an equal shadow cast by the true object.
findings.evidenceJa: 其は真物より落ちる同一の影
findings.governingReading: 真物より落ちる explicitly qualifies the otherwise identical image as inferior to the original.
findings.explanation: An inferior copy becomes an equal shadow.

findings.highlight: the experience of being depended on
findings.governingReading: 憑依された経験 is experience residing in/possessing the projected object.
findings.explanation: Possessed experience becomes being depended on.

findings.highlight: so that we don't let each other go.
findings.evidenceJa: どちらかを逃がさない為
findings.governingReading: Kuzuki maintains the standoff to prevent either Shirou or Rin from escaping.
findings.explanation: Kuzuki's effort to prevent either protagonist escaping becomes a shared intention to hold one another in place.

findings.evidenceJa: 悔しげに唇を噛んでいた
findings.governingReading: 悔しげ describes her frustration apparent in lip-biting.
findings.explanation: Rin’s vexation becomes a vexing action.
